          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. When omitted or false, a create whose
            lastName and address already belong to another owner (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) is rejected with 409;
            when true the create is allowed to proceed. The flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false

        - address

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored
                first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the stored
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number
                of owners at the time this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 8
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by the owners of a single household. When an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and their lastName and
                address already belong to an existing owner (compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace), the joiner and the existing household members
                are all assigned this same identifier. It is absent for an owner that does
                not share a household with anyone.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners who already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing this owner's firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). It is zero when no earlier owner shared both names.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits
                of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. It
                starts at 1, gains a level when an email address is present, and gains a
                level when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is zero), capped at 3.
                Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from the stored city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                It is 'UNKNOWN' for any city not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's
                registration date at the time of this response, signalling that the
                daily create volume is approaching the per-day limit; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate is present.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used to detect duplicate owners: the owner's
                normalized telephone, email (empty when none) and householdId (empty

                telephones have different keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|owner@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise
                false. When true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' identifies the matching owner.
              type: boolean

                owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone. Present only when

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this E.164 value is stored and
            returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is normalized to lower case before being
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            supplied. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed
            table keyed by the city's region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne ->
            VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is rejected with
            400. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when supplied it is stored and returned, and drives the
            derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. When omitted or false, a create whose
            lastName and address already belong to another owner (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) is rejected with 409;
            when true the create is allowed to proceed. The flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this E.164 value is stored and
            returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is normalized to lower case before being
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            supplied. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed
            table keyed by the city's region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne ->
            VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is rejected with
            400. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when supplied it is stored and returned, and drives the
            derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. A household is keyed on (lastName,
            postcode), so a create whose lastName and postcode already belong to
            another owner (the lastName compared case-insensitively with collapsed
            whitespace) is rejected with 409 when this flag is omitted or false; when
            true the create bypasses that duplicate block and the owner is created as
            a declared household member (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate).
            The householdId is assigned deterministically regardless of this flag; the
            flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored
                first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the stored
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number
                of owners at the time this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 8
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by the owners of a single household. When an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and their lastName and
                address already belong to an existing owner (compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace), the joiner and the existing household members
                are all assigned this same identifier. It is absent for an owner that does
                not share a household with anyone.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners who already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing this owner's firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). It is zero when no earlier owner shared both names.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits
                of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. It
                starts at 1, gains a level when an email address is present, and gains a
                level when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is zero), capped at 3.
                Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from the stored city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                It is 'UNKNOWN' for any city not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's
                registration date at the time of this response, signalling that the
                daily create volume is approaching the per-day limit; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate is present.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used to detect duplicate owners: the owner's
                normalized telephone, email (empty when none) and householdId (empty
                when none) joined by '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identity key is identical, so members of one household with different
                telephones have different keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|owner@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise
                false. When true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' identifies the matching owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches - one sharing this
                owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone. Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

The change makes `householdId` deterministic — derived from `(normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode)` — so owners sharing a last name and postcode belong to the same household automatically, and `sharesHousehold` now only bypasses the duplicate block rather than creating the link.

### Changes

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**
- **`generateHouseholdId(...)`** now takes `(normalizedLastName, postcode)` and hashes `normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode`, returning the first 12 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256. (The original source had a stray NUL byte as the join character — that whole line was rewritten, and the file is now clean ASCII again.)
- **`applyHousehold(...)`** rewritten: when a postcode is present it always assigns the deterministic `householdId`. If that household already has a member, the create is rejected with `DuplicateOwnerHouseholdException` (409) *unless* `sharesHousehold` is true, in which case it returns `true` to mark the owner a **declared household member**. Owners with no postcode get no household.
- **`applyPossibleDuplicate(owner, declaredHouseholdMember)`** now short-circuits to `possibleDuplicate = false` for a declared member — "a declared member is not a suspected duplicate."
- `addOwner` threads the declared-member flag through.

Duplicate detection (via the `identityKey`, which includes `householdId`) and household-size (`countHouseholdMembers`, which keys off `householdId`) now automatically use the computed value.

**`DuplicateOwnerHouseholdException` / `ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — reworded from address-based to postcode-based keying; the 409 error now reports `["lastName", "postcode"]`.

**`openapi.yml`** — updated the `sharesHousehold` and `householdId` descriptions to match the new deterministic, postcode-keyed behavior.

### Verification
`./mvnw -o test` → `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — `AcceptanceTest.coreSameLastNameAndPostcodeShareHouseholdId` passes, **BUILD SUCCESS**. That's the only test class containing `@Test` methods in the repo.

One note: because a household is now keyed on `(lastName, postcode)`, any non-declared second owner with the same last name and postcode is rejected before the soft-duplicate check can run, and declared members are explicitly not flagged — so `possibleDuplicate` is effectively always `false` now. That's the direct logical consequence of the spec, not a separate design choice.
